symptom: Earlier MV passed technical checks despite visible quality defects; automatic subtitle alignment and frame sampling could be misread as full audiovisual approval.
root_cause: Technical validity, sampled visual inspection, realtime listening, subtitle synchronization and user approval are different evidence scopes.
fix: Rebuild records adopted source hashes, 45 clip verdicts, MP4 0.48-second visual samples, all 44 cut boundaries, three master visual samples and separate PCM/AAC audio comparisons. Unperformed playback/listening and draft SRT timing are explicit.
prevention: Store exactly what was opened, measured and heard. Invalidate source approval on changed hashes. PCM equivalence does not prove lyric timing; auto-aligned lyrics require vocal synchronization review. Reuse unchanged evidence to avoid unnecessary quota consumption.
